fusions.name: Shed and Spat
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Spits a sting that deals 8 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Strike
fusions.desc: Spits a sun-heated sting that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Utter Stillness
fusions.desc: Freezes every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Blood
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%.
